title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 10 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode funny, heartwarming, and especially strong in its character-focused material.
The family relationships and Dara-san’s bond with them were widely appreciated.
Many enjoyed the costumes, playful humor, and Dara-san’s ongoing appeal.
Some felt the children’s behavior was entertaining but also excessive or suggestive, and one commenter thought Dara-san was partly pressured into participating.
One commenter felt the planned thirteen-episode season was too short and wished it had more episodes.
